title: The Crooked Wolf Revisited
author: Rosalind Nakamura
blurb: Tamsin Thornbury, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
